empty.description: The text of the timeline when it holds no record.

more.description: The button under the timeline's records that loads the next batch of them.

search.description: The placeholder of the timeline's search.

refresh.description: The button that fetches the timeline's records again, from the first.

text.description: The label of the search's text literal: the option that opens the quote and takes free text, leading the field panel.
